paragraphs: Yose ben Choni: beginning of Zevachim, chapter 1, in the Mishnah. Nazir 23a, Sotah 47a: Rabbi Yose ben Choni; Chelek 105b; Temurah 12b. Son of Rabbi Choni: Horayot 10b. Shimon, Azaryah’s brother—see his entry—disputes with him. If so, he would belong to the latter part of the Temple period.
